title: Affine torsion cohomological dimension bound
statement: For a field K with torsion cohomological dimension at most c, an affine finite-type K-scheme X of dimension at most d has Subsingleton (H^q(X,F)) for every torsion abelian etale sheaf F and every q with d + c < q.

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.hasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE_of_isAffine in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.AffineTorsionCohomologicalDimension, the existing upstream declaration of the affine bound thm-sc-affine-torsion-cd. Unfolding HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE identifies both the field hypothesis and conclusion with the displayed Sheaf.H statements; evaluate the conclusion at F, hF, q, hq.
